metadata.title: P49.5 Ultimate — P49 to P45 Readiness, Large-Plan Readiness, and ACCP Capability Certificate
metadata.description: Ultimate bridge plan between P49 and P45. P49 remains untouched. P49.5 verifies completed P49 outputs, probes ACCP compiler/gate/route/artifact capabilities, evaluates large-plan readiness, emits the P45 readiness certificate, and installs the P45-side prerequisite gate adapter. This is the final door-opening plan for P45: production P45 requires allow_p45, large-plan guarded mode requires large_plan_guarded_allowed, and uncertain readiness produces allow_fixture_only or block_p45.

notes: P49 is not modified by this plan.
P49.5 verifies P49 outputs and produces P45 readiness artifacts.
P45 consumes the P49.5 certificate instead of directly assuming P49 readiness.
ACCP route signals remain advisory and do not authorize P45 execution.

intent.summary: P49.5 is a bridge gate: it does not build P49 and it does not build P45 async assembly. It certifies whether P45 may start.

operatorNotes: P45 production mode is blocked unless P49.5 emits allow_p45.
allow_fixture_only is the safe decision when readiness is uncertain but fixture execution is useful.

mission.text: Verify completed P49 ACCP v2 substrate and emit the P45 readiness certificate that opens, limits, or blocks P45.

hardRequirements.text: Do not modify P49 implementation. P49.5 is a readiness bridge only.
P45 production mode requires a machine-readable allow_p45 certificate.
Missing, stale, or unverifiable P49 readiness must emit allow_fixture_only or block_p45, never allow_p45.
ACCP route signals remain advisory. The certificate does not grant mutation authority.

workspaces.title: P49 Completion Artifact Inventory and Readiness Input Contract
workspaces.description:
P49 Completion Artifact Inventory and Readiness Input Contract

Create a deterministic inventory of P49 outputs that P45 depends on: ACCP compiler package availability, route-signal compiler, gate-verdict compiler, artifact writer, report registry, runtime reads compiled JSON only, event/read-model visibility, and required/warn mode behavior. The inventory must record paths, hashes where available, and freshness metadata. It must not assume P49 success from the plan existing; it must inspect artifacts and test-visible exports.

This workspace belongs to P49.5, the bridge between the completed P49 ACCP v2 native substrate and the later P45 adaptive async assembly runtime. P49 itself must not be edited by this bridge plan. P49.5 consumes P49 outputs, verifies their runtime readiness, and emits a machine-readable certificate that P45 can trust. The bridge must not implement async assembly. It must not change P49's route bus, compiler package, TUI mode picker, or runtime gate implementation. It only verifies, normalizes, certificates, and exposes readiness data for P45.

The authority boundary remains unchanged: PlanSpec and runtime gates authorize execution; ACCP reports and route signals are evidence/recommendation artifacts; P45 is not allowed to start unless the P49.5 certificate says allow_p45. If P49 is incomplete or its outputs are not verifiable, the bridge must emit allow_fixture_only or block_p45 rather than allowing optimistic P45 execution.

instructions.text: Implement P49 Completion Artifact Inventory and Readiness Input Contract as a production-wired P49.5 bridge capability. It must consume existing P49 outputs and emit typed certificate artifacts without modifying P49 implementation files.
Do not edit P49 compiler, route bus, runtime gate, TUI mode picker, or ACCP source package. This bridge verifies readiness and produces certificates only.
P45 must not start in production mode unless the bridge certificate decision is allow_p45. allow_fixture_only permits fixture-only validation. block_p45 blocks all P45 runtime execution.

workspaces.title: P45 Readiness Certificate Schema and Decision Engine
workspaces.description:
P45 Readiness Certificate Schema and Decision Engine

Define the P45 readiness certificate schema and decision engine. The only valid decisions are allow_p45, allow_fixture_only, and block_p45. allow_p45 requires P49 readiness, ACCP compiler capability, gate verdict capability, route signal capability, artifact writer capability, runtime compiled-JSON-only policy, and no blocking dirty runtime status. Missing or stale evidence must not produce allow_p45.

workspaces.title: Large-Plan Readiness Probe for P45 Guarded Mode
workspaces.description: Probe whether completed P49 outputs can support guarded large-plan P45 mode. The probe profiles ACCP compiler throughput, artifact store capacity, event journal backpressure, dashboard/operator visibility capacity, compiled artifact volume, and route graph size. It emits large_plan_guarded_allowed, large_plan_fixture_only, or large_plan_blocked. This workspace does not enable P45 by itself; it only adds large-plan readiness data to the P49.5 certificate.

instructions.text: Implement Large-Plan Readiness Probe for P45 Guarded Mode as a bridge-owned P49.5 capability. It must verify P49 outputs without modifying P49.
Missing or stale evidence must produce fixture-only or blocked readiness, never green production readiness.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Large-Plan Readiness Probe for P45 Guarded Mode produces machine-readable output
acceptanceCriteria.text: Large-Plan Readiness Probe for P45 Guarded Mode writes the expected machine-readable readiness/profiling artifacts.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Large-Plan Readiness Probe for P45 Guarded Mode fails closed
acceptanceCriteria.text: Negative tests prove readiness is not allowed when P49 capacity signals are missing, stale, or red.

mitigations: Do not modify P49.
Profile capacity without enabling large plan mode by default.

requiredScenarios: attempt to mutate P49 files -> reject

requirements: ACCP capability probe passes positive and negative fixtures.
P45 readiness certificate exists and is machine-readable.
P45 prerequisite adapter consumes only the bridge certificate.
Final decision is allow_p45, allow_fixture_only, or block_p45.

largePlanReadinessProbe.purpose: Verify that the P49 ACCP substrate can support the artifact volume and visibility demands of guarded large-plan P45 mode without changing P49 itself.
hardRules: P49.5 may not mutate P49 implementation files.
Large plan readiness may be false even when allow_p45 is true.
allow_p45 opens normal P45; large_plan_guarded_allowed opens guarded large-plan mode.
large_plan_fixture_only permits only dry-run and fixture validation for large plans.
